US Judge Blocks Postal Service Mail-In Voting Restrictions

A U.S. federal judge has again blocked an executive order by former President Donald Trump that sought to limit mail-in voting. The order targeted the U.S. Postal Service's ability to implement new rules that could restrict mail-in voting. The judge's decision extends the previous block on these restrictions, impacting the upcoming midterm elections.
